services.name: Yacht Club
services.desc: The SPYC meets at the Marina Clubhouse at 4323 Saltspring Drive. All meetings begin with a potluck dinner at 6:30 PM and guests are always welcome! All meetings have interesting guest speakers, with a focus on safe and fun boating. The club utilizes the community barbecue pit during the summer when announced. Please see the schedule for dates. You don’t have to be a boat owner to join the club. Several of the cruises during the summer season are to destinations where the “Land Yacht” group of RV owners that are members can join the boaters for a fun weekend.
